verdict.rationale: PayPal's checkout integration lets a merchant offer PayPal, Venmo (a digital wallet), Pay Later (BNPL), and debit/credit cards together. Expanded Checkout builds on the same offerings with customizable card fields. Apple Pay and Google Pay appear only for in-person tap-to-pay through the PayPal app and for a separate Braintree agentic (UCP) handler, not as options in the same online checkout. Missing for 10: documented Apple Pay/Google Pay in the online checkout integration, bank-redirect/local payment methods, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-method acceptance from one integration.
